title: New parser-private completion attributes reject an existing custom make_parser producer
contract_basis: Command.make_parser is an existing documented factory; its parser subtype and parse_args tuple interface previously accepted this subclass. Completion bookkeeping must not become mandatory for unrelated normal calls.
reproduction: Subclass _OptionParser with parse_args returning ({}, list(args), []); return it from CustomCommand.make_parser; invoke an empty command callback through CliRunner with standalone_mode=False.
candidate_result: normal/-O exit1, AttributeError: AlternateParser object has no attribute _shell_complete_option
scope: Introduced normal-call regression, not a requirement to provide new completion behavior for every custom parser. The parser module is deprecated but the factory remains present in the source and official API.
